Subject: Proposed Meeting Time for Project Discussion

Dear [Manager/Colleague],

I hope this message finds you well. I would like to propose a meeting to discuss the progress of our current project. During the meeting, we can review the current status of the project, identify any roadblocks or issues, and plan our next steps moving forward.

Would you be available for a meeting next week on either Tuesday or Thursday at 2:00 PM? Please let me know if either of those times works for you, or if there is another time that would be more convenient. 

Thank you for your time and consideration.

Best regards,

[Your Name]

This message is polite, concise, and clearly states the purpose of the meeting. You can adjust the specifics as needed for your situation. Remember to always consider your audience
